title: Limits of v0.1 and qualification
summary: Limits: a commit covers one database (a NoSQLServer transaction is one database's; two are refused); parts load eagerly with the object, one query per part per object; generate max is MAX+1 within the unit of work, unsafe for writers in several processes; a mapped class's init takes no arguments; tables and columns are made by the Database Lab or a DBA, the map only checks. NoSQLServer has no IN (...) lists; JOIN and OR work; a foreign-key violation rolls the commit back. Qualification: tests/t_mapped.rex SCRATCH_DIR, 42 of 42 under ooRexx/WASM 0.2.4 in Node (REXX_PATH: this src, nosqlserver_v0.92-dev1, alchemy_objects_v0.8, oorexx_crypto_v0.1 src); Autobuild PASS 2026-11-15T04:07:26Z; Boston Crab v0.24 lint clean. Not run: concurrency, large graphs, native SQLite engine.
invariants: Do not claim multi-process key generation or cross-database commits.
SCRATCH_DIR must be a new, empty folder.
